pages.text: Nemean claw dagger: damage 6, attack speed 2.2, durability 1561. It wounds the Nemean Lion.$(br)Harpe of Perseus: damage 7, attack speed 1.6, durability 250. Double damage to Medusa.
Bident of Hades: one blow or right-click fells Cerberus at once, then it is gone.$(br)Promethean torch and Medusa's head: 32 uses.
